Ragas and Modes in C is designed to perfectly accommodate all ragas and modes in the key of C.

It also works beautifully for most ragas and modes in the key of F, and for “minor” ragas and modes in the keys of E and B (i.e., Raga Bhairavi or the Phrygian mode, Raga Asavri or the Aeolian mode, and Raga Kafi or the Dorian mode).

Note that the harmonically distant interval from F# to Db is a approximately an equal tempered fifth! As a result, every fourth and fifth sounds great, with the sole exception of the fifth from D to A, which sounds a syntonic comma flat from a perfect fifth.

In this tuning, the F#, C#, and G# keys are tuned lower than F, C, and G, creating three 64:63 septimal comma pairs. On the chart, those notes' cents deviations are given relative to their diatonic spelling, but the black keys need to be tuned down an extra semitone to get there: F# needs to be tuned down 127 cents, C# down 125, and G# down 123.
